item.name: Secret Wars
item.description:
Heroes and villains are torn from Earth and transported to Battleworld by the all-powerful Beyonder, who demands a simple bargain: defeat your enemies, and all your desires will be granted.

As icons like Spider-Man, Captain America, and Doctor Doom clash in a world built for war, alliances fracture and ambition rises—none more dangerous than Doom’s quest to seize ultimate power. In the chaos, battles reshape destinies, including the emergence of Spider-Man’s mysterious black suit.

Led by Jim Shooter and Mike Zeck, Secret Wars is Marvel’s first true mega-event—an explosive collision of its greatest heroes and villains on a cosmic stage.

item.name: Crisis on Infinite Earths
item.description:
The multiverse is dying. As wave after wave of antimatter erases entire realities, the enigmatic Monitor gathers heroes and villains from across infinite Earths for a final stand against the unstoppable Anti-Monitor.

Worlds fall, legends are lost, and icons like Supergirl and The Flash make the ultimate sacrifice to save what remains. In the end, the infinite becomes one—forever rewriting the history of the DC Universe.

Led by Marv Wolfman and George Pérez, Crisis on Infinite Earths is the definitive DC epic—the story that collapsed a multiverse into a single reality and redefined everything that followed.

issues.series_name: Last Days of the Justice Society Special

item.name: Secret Wars II
item.description:
Returned from Battleworld, the all-powerful Beyonder comes to Earth seeking to understand humanity—taking human form and inserting himself into the lives of heroes, villains, and ordinary people alike.

But as limitless power collides with human desire, morality, and fear, his search for meaning spirals into chaos, drawing the entire Marvel Universe into a sprawling series of encounters that blur the line between godhood and humanity.

Led by Jim Shooter and Al Milgrom, Secret Wars II expands Marvel’s first mega-event into a universe-spanning experiment—where the greatest question isn’t who wins, but what it means to be human.

item.name: Legends
item.description: When Darkseid targets Earth, he doesn’t launch an invasion—he turns humanity against its own heroes. Fear spreads, trust collapses, and the world begins to question the very idea of superheroes. As chaos erupts across the globe, Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, Captain Marvel, and the Flash must stand together to prove that hope still matters. Written by John Ostrander and Len Wein with iconic art by George Pérez, Legends (1986) is the explosive post-Crisis on Infinite Earths event that reshaped the DC Universe and ushered in a bold new generation of heroes.

item.name: Mutant Massacre
item.description: The Marauders descend into the tunnels beneath Manhattan, slaughtering the Morlocks and drawing the X-Men, X-Factor, the New Mutants, and even Thor into one of mutantkind’s darkest hours. Written by Chris Claremont, Louise Simonson, and others, Mutant Massacre is the first major X-Men crossover event—a brutal turning point that leaves lasting scars across the mutant world.

item.name: Millennium
item.description: When the immortal Guardians of the Universe return to Earth with a mysterious plan to guide humanity’s next evolutionary leap, they reveal a terrifying truth: the ancient Manhunters have secretly infiltrated every corner of society. Heroes across the DC Universe must uncover the hidden traitors among them while protecting a group of chosen humans destined to become the next generation of protectors. Millennium (1987) is the cosmic crossover that expanded the DC Universe, introduced the New Guardians, and exposed a conspiracy millions of years in the making.

item.name: Fall of the Mutants
item.description: As anti-mutant hysteria rises across America, the X-Men face death in Dallas, X-Factor confronts Apocalypse, and the New Mutants are forced into a battle that will cost them one of their own. Written by Chris Claremont and Louise Simonson, Fall of the Mutants is not one story but three linked turning points that reshape the mutant line and launch the X-Men into a bold new era.

item.name: Inferno
item.description:
As demonic forces pour into New York and the city twists into a living nightmare, the X-Men, X-Factor, and New Mutants are dragged into a war where old sins finally come due.

At the center of the chaos, Madelyne Pryor’s transformation into the Goblin Queen turns personal betrayal into supernatural catastrophe, while Mister Sinister’s hidden manipulations push mutantkind toward one of its darkest reckonings.

Led by Chris Claremont, Louise Simonson, Marc Silvestri, Walter Simonson, Bret Blevins, and Jon Bogdanove, Inferno is a defining X-Men crossover—where demons, clones, and broken families collide as the private trauma of mutants spills into the streets of Marvel’s New York.

item.name: Invasion!
item.description: Earth’s greatest strength has made it the galaxy’s greatest threat. An alien alliance led by the Dominators launches an invasion to crush humanity’s superpowered potential. Outnumbered and under siege, DC’s heroes rally to defend their world—but the invaders have a weapon that could turn Earth’s defenders into its casualties.

issues.series_name: The Saga of the Swamp Thing
The Saga of the Swamp Thing

item.name: The Evolutionary War
item.description: The High Evolutionary has judged humanity unfit to survive as it is—and now he means to force the next step in mankind’s evolution, no matter the cost. From the sewers beneath New York to the Savage Land and the stars beyond, heroes across the Marvel Universe must unite against a global campaign of genetic conquest in The Evolutionary War, a sprawling annuals crossover by Louise Simonson, Chris Claremont, Steve Englehart, Gerry Conway, Mark Gruenwald, and more.

item.name: Acts of Vengeance
item.description:
When Marvel’s greatest villains realize they keep losing to the same heroes, they make a simple, dangerous choice: switch targets. Led from the shadows by Loki, a secret cabal sends unfamiliar enemies against heroes who have never faced them before, turning the Marvel Universe into a battlefield of mismatched grudges and unexpected threats.

As Spider-Man, the Avengers, the Fantastic Four, and heroes across the line are hit from all sides, the chaos reveals how fragile even the strongest champions can be when the rules of rivalry are rewritten.

Led by Walt Simonson, John Byrne, David Michelinie, Mark Gruenwald, and other Marvel creators, Acts of Vengeance is a classic line-wide crossover built on one irresistible idea: what happens when the villains finally learn to coordinate?

item.name: Atlantis Attacks
item.description:
The serpent god Set moves from myth into conquest, manipulating ancient powers and modern monsters in a campaign to return to Earth. As Atlantis, Lemuria, Deviants, Serpent Crowns, and sea-born empires collide, heroes across the Marvel Universe are pulled into a sprawling war rooted in ancient evil.

From the Avengers and Fantastic Four to Spider-Man, X-Factor, and the Punisher, the conflict spreads through Marvel’s annuals as scattered battles reveal one larger design: a ritual of domination that could place the world under Set’s coils.

Led by Mark Gruenwald, Steve Englehart, Peter Sanderson, Gerry Conway, Roy Thomas, and other Marvel creators, Atlantis Attacks is a classic annual-driven crossover—where ocean kingdoms, serpent gods, and superhero chaos collide in one of Marvel’s earliest attempts at a line-wide event.

item.name: The Janus Directive
item.description: A secret order known as the Janus Directive suddenly activates, turning America’s covert agencies against one another. Checkmate, the Suicide Squad, Project Atom, and other black-ops teams are thrown into a shadow war of espionage, sabotage, and betrayal as each group believes the others have gone rogue. But behind the chaos lies a deeper conspiracy manipulating events from the shadows. The Janus Directive (1989) is a high-stakes DC crossover where spies, operatives, and reluctant heroes collide in a deadly game of intelligence and deception.

item.name: X-Tinction Agenda
item.description: Genosha has taken its captives—and now the X-Men, X-Factor, and the New Mutants must unite to bring them home before Cameron Hodge turns them into slaves of the mutant nation’s brutal regime. From Chris Claremont, Louise Simonson, Jim Lee, Rob Liefeld, and Jon Bogdanove, X-Tinction Agenda brings Marvel’s mutant teams together against one of their most ruthless enemies in a desperate fight for freedom.

item.name: Armageddon 2001
item.description: A visitor from the future arrives with a chilling warning: in the year 2001, one of Earth’s greatest heroes will become the tyrant Monarch and plunge the world into ruin. The mysterious time traveler Waverider journeys through the lives of the DC Universe’s heroes—peering into their possible futures to discover which one will betray everything they stand for. As secrets, fears, and dark destinies are revealed, Armageddon 2001 (1991) becomes a race against time to stop a future that may already be inevitable.

item.name: The Infinity Gauntlet
item.description:
When the Mad Titan Thanos claims the six Infinity Gems, he becomes a god—and with a single act, wipes out half of all life in the universe to prove his devotion to Death.

As reality itself bends to his will, Earth’s mightiest heroes launch a desperate assault, only to fall before his absolute power. With the cosmos on the brink, a final gambit led by Adam Warlock and a coalition of cosmic forces offers the only chance to challenge a being who has already won.

Led by Jim Starlin, George Pérez, and Ron Lim, The Infinity Gauntlet is Marvel’s definitive cosmic epic—where power becomes absolute, and the fate of existence hangs on those willing to defy it.

item.name: War of the Gods
item.description: The ancient gods of myth go to war—and Earth becomes their battlefield. When the sorceress Circe sparks a conflict between the pantheons of Olympus, Asgard, Egypt, and beyond, the chaos threatens both the mortal world and the heavens themselves. Caught at the center of the storm, Wonder Woman must confront gods, monsters, and rival champions to stop a divine war that could reshape reality. Written and illustrated by George Pérez, War of the Gods (1991) is a sweeping mythological crossover that unleashes the full power of the DC Universe’s gods.

item.name: Death and Return of Superman
item.description: A monstrous force named Doomsday tears across America, leaving destruction in its wake and forcing the Justice League to its knees. Only Superman stands in the creature’s path, and their brutal battle ends with the impossible—the death of the Man of Steel. But the story doesn’t end there. In the aftermath, four mysterious new Supermen rise to claim his legacy as the world wonders if its greatest hero is truly gone. The Death and Return of Superman (1992–1993) is the legendary saga that shocked the world, transformed Metropolis, and proved that even death cannot end a legend.

issues.series_name: Superman: The Man of Steel Annual

item.name: Eclipso: The Darkness Within
item.description: An ancient evil rises from the shadows when the mysterious Black Diamond unleashes Eclipso, a dark spirit of vengeance capable of possessing anyone who touches its cursed shards. As fragments of the diamond spread across the world, heroes and villains alike fall under Eclipso’s control, turning the DC Universe against itself. With allies becoming enemies and darkness spreading everywhere, Earth’s champions must find a way to stop a force that feeds on their own inner rage. Eclipso: The Darkness Within (1992) is a chilling crossover where the greatest threat isn’t just evil—it’s the darkness within.

issues.series_name: Superman: The Man of Steel Annual

item.name: Knightfall
item.description: Gotham City faces its darkest hour when the ruthless mastermind Bane engineers a massive breakout at Arkham Asylum, unleashing Batman’s entire rogue’s gallery on the city at once. Exhausted and pushed beyond his limits, Batman finally confronts Bane—and suffers a devastating defeat that shatters the legend of the Dark Knight. With Bruce Wayne broken, a new and far more ruthless Batman rises in his place, threatening to turn Gotham’s protector into something far more dangerous. Knightfall (1993) is the iconic Batman epic that broke the Bat and forever changed the legacy of Gotham’s greatest hero.

item.name: The Infinity War
item.description:
When the dark side of Adam Warlock takes form as the ruthless Magus, a shadow war erupts across the universe. Twisted doppelgängers of Earth’s heroes and villains rise in their place, unleashing chaos as the real champions struggle to reclaim their identities and survive their own darkest reflections.

As cosmic forces collide and reality teeters on collapse, an uneasy alliance forms between former enemies—including Thanos—to stop a threat born from within. In a battle where the greatest danger is the self, victory demands more than power—it requires confronting what lies beneath it.

Led by Jim Starlin and Ron Lim, The Infinity War expands the cosmic saga into a darker, more personal conflict—where every hero must face the enemy they cannot escape.

Silver Sable and the Wild Pack

item.name: X-Cutioner’s Song
item.description: Professor X has been shot. Cyclops and Jean Grey have been taken. And all evidence points to Cable. As the X-Men, X-Factor, and X-Force turn on one another in a hunt for the truth, Stryfe sets a vengeance-fueled scheme in motion that will drag mutantkind into war and expose deadly secrets from the Summers bloodline. From Scott Lobdell, Fabian Nicieza, Peter David, Andy Kubert, Greg Capullo, and more, X-Cutioner’s Song is a high-stakes mutant thriller of betrayal, identity, and revenge.

item.name: Bloodlines
item.description: A deadly alien invasion begins when mysterious parasites arrive on Earth, feeding on human spinal fluid and leaving a trail of destruction behind them. But some victims survive the attack—emerging with strange new powers and becoming the first of the “New Blood” heroes. As the parasites multiply and the threat spreads, the heroes of the DC Universe must stop the invasion before humanity becomes their next meal. Bloodlines (1993) is the massive annual crossover that unleashed a wave of new heroes and a terrifying extraterrestrial menace across the DC Universe.

issues.series_name: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight

item.name: Fatal Attractions
item.description: Magneto has returned—and his war for mutant supremacy will shake the world to its core. As the Acolytes escalate their crusade against humanity, the X-Men are drawn into a final confrontation with their greatest enemy, one that will tear the adamantium from Wolverine’s bones and push Professor Xavier past a line he can never uncross. From Scott Lobdell, Fabian Nicieza, Peter David, J.M. DeMatteis, Larry Hama, and more, Fatal Attractions is a brutal anniversary crossover that forever changes the X-Men’s war with Magneto.

item.name: Infinity Crusade
item.description: The Goddess has come to save the universe from evil—even if salvation means the end of free will itself. As Earth’s most devout heroes fall under her spell and join her holy crusade, the rest of the Marvel Universe must stand against their own allies to stop paradise from becoming annihilation. From Jim Starlin and Ron Lim, The Infinity Crusade brings the cosmic saga begun in Infinity Gauntlet to its final battle.

item.name: Maximum Carnage
item.description: Carnage is loose—and this time, he is not alone. As Cletus Kasady and his murderous “family” turn New York City into a slaughterhouse, Spider-Man must join forces with Venom and a desperate band of heroes to stop a wave of madness that threatens to consume the city whole. From Tom DeFalco, J.M. DeMatteis, David Michelinie, Terry Kavanagh, Mark Bagley, Sal Buscema, Ron Lim, Alex Saviuk, and more, Maximum Carnage unleashes one of Spider-Man’s bloodiest and most infamous battles.

item.name: Trinity
item.description: A cosmic conspiracy draws three of the DC Universe’s interstellar forces into a deadly collision. When a mysterious enemy manipulates events from the shadows, the Green Lantern Corps, the Darkstars, and L.E.G.I.O.N. find themselves caught in a conflict that threatens the balance of power across the galaxy. Old rivalries ignite, alliances fracture, and the truth behind the plot could reshape the future of cosmic justice. Trinity (1993) is the explosive crossover where three spacefaring legacies collide in a battle for the fate of the universe.

item.name: Fall of Metropolis
item.description: Metropolis faces its greatest catastrophe when the city itself becomes the target of a devastating conspiracy. As Lex Luthor and the alien tyrant Brainiac unleash a plan that threatens to destroy—or even steal—the City of Tomorrow, Superman and his allies must fight to save the people who call it home. With the fate of Metropolis hanging in the balance, Fall of Metropolis (1994) delivers a massive Superman crossover where the Man of Steel must prove that even when a city falls, hope can still rise.

item.name: The Phalanx Covenant
item.description: The X-Men have been taken—and the enemy wearing their faces is already inside the mansion. As the techno-organic Phalanx move to assimilate mutantkind, Banshee, Emma Frost, Sabretooth, and Jubilee become the last hope for a new generation of young mutants whose survival may decide the future of the X-Men. From Scott Lobdell, Fabian Nicieza, Larry Hama, Joe Madureira, Andy Kubert, and more, The Phalanx Covenant launches the next generation of mutant heroes in a desperate war against assimilation.

item.name: Worlds Collide
item.description: Two universes meet when the heroes of DC Comics collide with the champions of Milestone. When a cosmic crisis threatens both realities, icons from each world—Superman, Superboy, Steel, Icon, Hardware, Static, and the Blood Syndicate—must join forces to stop a threat that neither universe can face alone. As worlds merge and heroes clash before becoming allies, Worlds Collide (1994) becomes a landmark crossover that unites two comic book universes in one explosive event.

item.name: Zero Hour
item.description: Time itself begins to unravel as a mysterious force rewrites history across the DC Universe. Heroes vanish, past and future collide, and entire timelines collapse into chaos. At the center of the crisis stands Hal Jordan, now transformed into the reality-warping power of Parallax, determined to remake the universe according to his own vision. As the surviving heroes race to stop the collapse of ex

item.name: Age of Apocalypse
item.description:
When Professor Xavier is killed before he can form the X-Men, history breaks—and a nightmare replaces the Marvel Universe. In this altered world, Apocalypse rules North America, Magneto leads a desperate resistance, and familiar heroes are reborn as darker, stranger versions of themselves.

As the last free mutants fight to undo a reality built on conquest and survival, the line between hero and weapon begins to blur. Saving the world means restoring a timeline that no longer exists—and sacrificing a reality where some heroes have become legends in their own right.

Led by Scott Lobdell, Mark Waid, Fabian Nicieza, Jeph Loeb, Andy Kubert, Joe Madureira, Roger Cruz, and Steve Epting, Age of Apocalypse is Marvel’s defining alternate-reality crossover—where one death creates a world without hope, and the X-Men become the last rebellion against extinction.

item.name: Trial of Superman
item.description: Superman is taken from Earth and placed on trial before a powerful alien tribunal, forced to answer for the ultimate question: has he done more harm than good to the universe? As old enemies and uneasy allies gather as witnesses, the Man of Steel must defend not just his actions, but the very idea of what he represents. Meanwhile, forces on Earth and beyond move in the shadows, threatening to turn the trial into something far more dangerous. Trial of Superman (1995) is a cosmic crossover that puts the DC Universe’s greatest hero on judgment day.

item.name: Underworlds Unleashed
item.description: When the demon lord Neron rises from Hell with a simple offer—ultimate power in exchange for a soul—the villains of the DC Universe line up to make their deal. As rogues are transformed into deadlier versions of themselves and temptation spreads across the world, heroes must resist corruption and stop a bargain that could damn humanity. Underworld Unleashed (1995) is a dark, supernatural crossover where the greatest threat isn’t just evil—it’s the price you’re willing to pay for power.

item.name: Contagion/Legacy
item.description: A deadly virus devastates Gotham City, turning it into a quarantined nightmare as Batman and the Bat-family race to contain an outbreak that threatens millions. But the horror is only the beginning. In the aftermath, the trail leads to Ra’s al Ghul, whose global plan pushes the crisis beyond Gotham and into a far more dangerous stage. As the stakes escalate from survival to prevention of worldwide catastrophe, Contagion and Legacy (1996–1997) form a gripping, interconnected saga where disease, desperation, and eco-terror collide—and the Dark Knight must stop a threat that could wipe out humanity itself.

item.name: Final Night
item.description: The sun goes out—and with it, all hope. When the unstoppable Sun-Eater devours Earth’s star, the world is plunged into freezing darkness as heroes and villains alike struggle to survive the end of everything. With time running out, unlikely alliances form and desperate plans unfold, but only one being may have the power to reignite the light. Final Night (1996) is a chilling, high-stakes DC crossover where sacrifice becomes the only way to save the world.

item.name: Onslaught Saga
item.description:
Born from the darkest corners of Professor X and Magneto, Onslaught rises as a psychic nightmare with the power to bend minds, shatter heroes, and remake the world in his image.

As the X-Men face the terrifying truth behind their mentor’s corruption, the crisis expands beyond mutantkind, drawing in the Avengers, Fantastic Four, and heroes across the Marvel Universe for a final stand against a monster born from their greatest ideals and deepest failures.

Led by Scott Lobdell, Mark Waid, Jeph Loeb, Andy Kubert, and Joe Madureira, Onslaught is a universe-shaking crossover where the sins of the past become a living apocalypse—and victory changes Marvel’s heroes forever.

item.name: Genesis
item.description: A mysterious cosmic force known as the Godwave surges across the universe, disrupting the very source of power for heroes and gods alike. As abilities fluctuate, technologies fail, and chaos spreads, the New Gods of New Genesis and Apokolips move to contain a phenomenon that could reshape the balance between mortals and divinity. With the fate of power itself hanging in the balance, Genesis (1997) is a sweeping cosmic crossover that redefines where strength comes from—and who controls it.

item.name: Operation: Zero Tolerance
item.description: Bastion has declared war on mutantkind. Backed by a rogue government faction and an army of human sleeper agents transformed into Prime Sentinels, Operation: Zero Tolerance strikes at the X-Men from every side, leaving the team captured, scattered, and hunted in their darkest hour. From Scott Lobdell, Larry Hama, James Robinson, Joe Madureira, Carlos Pacheco, Chris Bachalo, and more, the mutant line erupts into a desperate fight for survival against a machine-made future built on extermination.

item.name: DC One Million
item.description: The future of the DC Universe arrives in the present when heroes from the 853rd century travel back in time, bringing with them a warning of an ancient threat waiting to strike. As the Justice League meets their far-future counterparts, a plan unfolds that spans centuries, stars, and the very heart of the sun itself. At the center of it all stands Superman Prime One Million, a being of unimaginable power—and the key to saving (or dooming) the future. DC One Million (1998) is a bold, high-concept crossover that stretches the DC Universe across time and redefines the legacy of its greatest heroes.

item.name: Ghosts
item.description: On a night when the veil between worlds grows thin, the heroes of the DC Universe come face to face with the supernatural. From restless spirits to haunting visions of the past, each encounter forces them to confront fears that can’t be fought with strength alone. As eerie forces move in the shadows, even the greatest heroes must question what lies beyond life—and what refuses to stay buried. Ghosts (1998) is a chilling, atmospheric crossover where the unknown becomes the true enemy.

item.name: No Man's Land
item.description: Gotham City has fallen. After a catastrophic earthquake shatters it beyond repair, the government abandons the city—leaving it cut off, lawless, and carved into territories ruled by gangs, villains, and the desperate. In the wake of Cataclysm and Aftershock, only Batman and the Bat-family stand between total anarchy and the faint hope of rebuilding. But this is a war fought block by block, ally by ally, where survival comes before justice and every victory is hard-earned. No Man’s Land (1998–1999) is a brutal, defining saga where Gotham becomes a battlefield—and the legend of the Dark Knight is forged in its darkest hour.

item.name: Day of Judgment
item.description: Hell is unleashed when the power of the Spectre falls into the wrong hands, turning divine judgment into a force of chaos. As demons flood the Earth and magic spirals out of control, heroes and mystics alike—led by figures like Etrigan and Zatanna—must unite to stop a supernatural apocalypse. At the center of it all stands Hal Jordan, seeking redemption as he becomes the new host of the Spectre and restores balance between vengeance and justice. Day of Judgment (1999) is a dark, mystical crossover that reshapes the magical side of the DC Universe.

item.name: JLApe: Gorilla Warfare!
item.description: Chaos erupts when Gorilla Grodd unleashes a plan that transforms the world’s greatest heroes into beasts, twisting the Justice League into primal versions of themselves. As civilization teeters on the edge and Gorilla City rises to power, the remaining heroes must fight through instinct, identity, and Grodd’s growing control to restore the world. JLApe: Gorilla Warfare! (1999) is a wild, high-energy crossover where intellect battles instinct—and even legends can lose themselves to the animal within.

item.name: The Flash: Chain Lightning
item.description: A deadly enemy emerges from the shadows of history to hunt the Flash legacy across time. As Cobalt Blue strikes at speedsters past, present, and future, Wally West is pulled into a desperate race through generations of heroes—including Barry Allen and those yet to come. With the Speed Force itself under threat, Wally must confront the legacy he carries and the destiny he’s trying to outrun. The Flash: Chain Lightning (2001) is a fast-paced, time-spanning saga that defines what it truly means to be the Flash.

item.name: Circle of Fire
item.description: Reality fractures around Kyle Rayner as he is thrust into a series of strange, alternate worlds—each one featuring a different version of the Green Lantern legacy. As he struggles to understand what’s real and what’s been manipulated, a hidden enemy known as Oblivion emerges, threatening to erase Kyle—and the very idea of Green Lantern—from existence. Circle of Fire (2000) is a mind-bending crossover that explores identity, legacy, and the power of will across multiple realities.

item.name: Emperor Joker
item.description: When the Joker steals the reality-warping power of Mr. Mxyzptlk, he reshapes the universe into his own twisted playground—one where logic is meaningless, suffering is endless, and even death offers no escape. Heroes are broken, histories are rewritten, and Batman is doomed to relive the same horrific fate over and over again. As the madness spirals beyond control, only Superman stands against a godlike Joker, fighting to restore reality before chaos becomes permanent. Emperor Joker (2000) is a dark, high-concept saga where the Clown Prince of Crime finally gets everything he ever wanted—and the universe pays the price.

item.name: Maximum Security
item.description: Earth has been sentenced. Deemed too dangerous for the wider galaxy, humanity’s home is transformed into an interstellar prison colony—and the worst criminals in the cosmos are dumped on its doorstep. As alien convicts overrun the planet and Ego the Living Planet closes in, Earth’s heroes must fight to save a world the universe has already condemned. From Kurt Busiek and Jerry Ordway, Maximum Security turns the Marvel Universe into the galaxy’s deadliest cell block.

item.name: Joker's Last Laugh
item.description: Believing he is dying, the Joker unleashes one final punchline and infects villains across the DC Universe with a twisted version of his toxin, turning them into laughing agents of chaos. Heroes scramble to contain the spreading madness as alliances fracture and trust collapses, forcing them to fight former allies and unpredictable enemies alike. At the center of it all, Nightwing faces a defining moment that reshapes his relationship with Batman. Joker: Last Laugh (2001) delivers a dark, volatile crossover where the Clown Prince of Crime proves that chaos always gets the last laugh.

issues.series_name: Joker: Last Laugh Secret Files & Origins

item.name: Our Worlds At War
item.description: A cosmic war engulfs the DC Universe when the unstoppable force known as Imperiex arrives to destroy existence itself and remake the universe from its ashes. As entire worlds fall and armies clash across space, Superman, his allies, and even former enemies must unite against a threat beyond comprehension. But as the battle escalates, the true mastermind behind the chaos begins to emerge, turning the war into something even more dangerous. Our Worlds at War (2001) is a massive, high-stakes crossover where survival means standing together against the end of everything.

item.name: President Lex Luthor
item.description: Lex Luthor has achieved the ultimate victory—not by defeating Superman, but by winning the presidency of the United States. With the power of the government behind him, Luthor reshapes the world on his terms while presenting himself as humanity’s greatest champion. Bound by law and public trust, Superman can’t simply strike him down—he has to outmaneuver a man who now holds legitimate power over the very people he protects. As suspicion grows and secrets unravel, Superman: President Lex (2000–2001) becomes a high-stakes battle of ideals where truth, authority, and heroism collide—and the greatest threat to Superman wears a suit and tie.

issues.series_name: President Luthor Secret Files and Origins

item.name: Bruce Wayne: Murderer?
item.description: When Bruce Wayne is accused of murder, the unthinkable happens—he refuses to defend himself and abandons his civilian identity entirely. As the evidence mounts and Gotham turns against him, the Bat-family races to uncover the truth while Batman operates from the shadows, cutting himself off from the life he once lived. But as the manhunt intensifies and trust begins to fracture, the question becomes more dangerous than the crime itself: is Bruce Wayne just a mask—and is Batman all that’s left? Bruce Wayne: Murderer? / Fugitive (2002) is a gripping crossover that pushes the Dark Knight to the edge and forces him to confront who he really is.

item.name: JSA: Black Reign
item.description: When Black Adam seizes control of the nation of Kahndaq, he doesn’t ask for permission—he takes it, ruling with absolute power and reshaping the country in his image. As stability replaces chaos through force, the Justice Society of America faces an impossible question: overthrow a dictator, or respect a sovereign nation that finally has order. With loyalties tested and ideals pushed to their limits, JSA: Black Reign (2003) delivers a gripping clash of power, politics, and legacy where the line between hero and ruler begins to blur.

item.name: Avengers Disassembled
item.description: The Avengers are under attack from within. As impossible disasters tear through Avengers Mansion and old friends fall one by one, Earth’s Mightiest Heroes face an enemy who knows their every weakness—and a betrayal that will shatter the team forever. From Brian Michael Bendis and David Finch, Avengers Disassembled destroys the classic Avengers era and clears the wreckage for a darker, more dangerous Marvel Universe.

item.name: Identity Crisis
item.description: A brutal murder tears through the superhero community when someone kills Sue Dibny, the wife of the Elongated Man, and turns friends into suspects. As the Justice League races to uncover the truth, buried secrets claw their way back to the surface—choices that cross lines, violate trust, and haunt every hero involved. Suspicion spreads, loyalties crack, and the very idea of heroism begins to unravel under the weight of what they’ve done to protect themselves. Crafted by Brad Meltzer with haunting, grounded art by Rags Morales, Identity Crisis (2004) dives headfirst into grief, guilt, and moral ambiguity, casting a long, uneasy shadow over the DC Universe.

item.name: Decimation
item.description: The world wakes up to a new reality: millions of mutants have lost their powers, and only a few hundred remain. In the aftermath of House of M, the X-Men must protect an endangered species from enemies old and new while mutantkind struggles to survive the day after “No more mutants.” From Chris Claremont, Peter David, Paul Jenkins, David Hine, Nunzio DeFilippis, Christina Weir, and more, Decimation begins one of the darkest eras in X-Men history.

issues.series_name: Decimation: House of M - The Day After

item.name: House of M
item.description:
When reality fractures under the power of Scarlet Witch, the world is remade into a perfect illusion—one where mutants rule, Magneto stands victorious, and every hero lives their deepest desire.

But as memories begin to resurface, a small group led by Wolverine realizes the truth: this paradise is a lie. As reality unravels, the cost of restoring the world may be catastrophic—culminating in a single, devastating act that reshapes the future of mutantkind forever.

Led by Brian Michael Bendis and Olivier Coipel, House of M is a defining Marvel event—where power rewrites reality, and the consequences echo across an entire generation.

issues.series_name: Decimation: House of M - The Day After

item.name: Infinite Crisis
item.description: The DC Universe stands on the edge as old wounds, broken trust, and rising chaos push its greatest heroes toward collapse. From the shadows, survivors of a lost world—led by Alexander Luthor and the reality-shattering Superboy-Prime—set a plan in motion to remake existence itself, no matter the cost. As war erupts across Earth and beyond, Superman, Batman, and Wonder Woman struggle to hold everything together while their own ideals begin to fracture. Written by Geoff Johns with sweeping, cinematic art by Phil Jimenez, Infinite Crisis (2005–2006) channels legacy, sacrifice, and the weight of history into a universe-spanning conflict where every choice reshapes what comes next.

item.name: The Other: Evolve or Die
item.description: Peter Parker is dying. A mysterious illness is eating him from the inside out, and not even the Avengers or Doctor Strange can stop it. Enter Morlun, a brutal multiversal predator who beats Spider-Man to the brink of death. Defeated and broken, Peter passes away—only to awaken inside a mystical cocoon under the Brooklyn Bridge. Faced with a cosmic spider-deity, he is given a terrifying ultimatum: evolve or die. Choosing to embrace his primal totem side, Spider-Man is reborn with terrifying new abilities, but cheating death leaves him forever altered.

item.name: Annihilation
item.description:
When Annihilus breaks through from the Negative Zone with an endless war fleet, the universe faces extinction on a scale Earth’s heroes barely understand. Worlds fall, empires collapse, and cosmic champions like Nova, Silver Surfer, Drax, and Ronan are forced into a desperate alliance against a force that does not want conquest—it wants annihilation.

As the Annihilation Wave tears across space, Marvel’s forgotten cosmic heroes become the last line of defense in a war too vast for the Avengers to fight.

Led by Keith Giffen, Dan Abnett, Andy Lanning, Andrea Di Vito, Kev Walker, and other creators, Annihilation is the explosive rebirth of modern cosmic Marvel—where survival belongs not to the strongest, but to those willing to stand when the universe itself is falling.

item.name: Civil War
item.description:
When a catastrophic disaster forces the U.S. government to impose the Superhuman Registration Act, the Marvel Universe fractures along ideological lines. Iron Man leads the charge for oversight and accountability, while Captain America stands for personal freedom—igniting a conflict that turns allies into enemies.

As heroes choose sides and the war escalates, identities are exposed, friendships shattered, and the very idea of heroism is put on trial. In a battle where there are no easy answers, victory comes at the cost of unity—and changes the Marvel Universe forever.

Led by Mark Millar and Steve McNiven, Civil War is a defining Marvel event—where the greatest threat isn’t a villain, but division itself.

item.name: Amazons Attack!
item.description: War erupts when Queen Hippolyta leads the Amazons in a full-scale assault on Washington, D.C., bringing myth and modern power into violent collision. As the Amazons carve a path through the world’s most powerful city, Wonder Woman finds herself caught between her people and the heroes sworn to stop them. Alliances strain, loyalties fracture, and every battle forces a deeper question—where does duty end, and where does identity begin? Driven by spectacle and moral conflict, Amazons Attack (2007) pits honor against consequence as the DC Universe grapples with the cost of war.

item.name: Annihilation: Conquest
item.description:
In the ashes of the Annihilation War, the universe barely has time to breathe before a new threat rises. The techno-organic Phalanx spread across Kree space, converting worlds into extensions of their hive mind and trapping entire civilizations behind an impenetrable barrier.

As Star-Lord, Nova, Quasar, Wraith, and a newly assembled band of cosmic misfits fight back, the war reveals a darker intelligence behind the invasion: Ultron, reborn on a galactic scale.

Led by Dan Abnett, Andy Lanning, Keith Giffen, Christos Gage, Tom Raney, Mike Perkins, and other creators, Annihilation: Conquest is the next great cosmic war—where survival means resisting assimilation, and Marvel’s modern Guardians begin to take shape.

item.name: Green Arrow & Black Canary: The Wedding
item.description: What should be a celebration turns into chaos when Green Arrow and Black Canary finally tie the knot—and their enemies crash the ceremony with deadly intent. As vows give way to violence, the wedding becomes a battleground that tests not just their skills, but the strength of their bond. Secrets surface, danger closes in, and nothing about this union goes as planned. Written by Judd Winick with dynamic art by Amanda Conner, Green Arrow & Black Canary: The Wedding (2007) blends romance and mayhem into a story where love doesn’t just endure the fight—it survives it.

item.name: Messiah Complex/Messiah War/Second Coming
item.description:
The first mutant born after M-Day becomes the center of mutantkind’s last hope—and its greatest war. In the future, Cable and Hope are hunted across time by enemies determined to prevent her from ever reaching the present, while X-Force is pulled into a brutal conflict against Bishop, Stryfe, and Apocalypse.

When Hope finally returns, the war comes home. Bastion launches a coordinated assault to exterminate the remaining mutants, trapping the X-Men in a desperate final stand where survival depends on protecting the girl who may restart their entire species.

Led by Craig Kyle, Christopher Yost, Duane Swierczynski, Mike Choi, Ariel Olivetti, David Finch, and other creators, Messiah War / Second Coming is the explosive payoff to the post-House of M mutant survival saga—where extinction, prophecy, and sacrifice collide around the future of mutantkind.

item.name: The Resurrection of Ra's al Ghul
item.description: Ra’s al Ghul stands on the brink of death—and his followers will stop at nothing to bring him back. As the League of Assassins launches a global hunt for the means to restore their master, Batman, Nightwing, and Robin race across continents to stop the resurrection before it begins. At the center of the conflict, Damian Wayne becomes both pawn and prize, forcing Batman to confront the legacy of his greatest enemy in a deeply personal way. Written by Grant Morrison and Paul Dini with a rotating team of artists, The Resurrection of Ra’s al Ghul (2007) blends mysticism, legacy, and high-stakes pursuit into a story where death never stays buried—and every victory comes with a cost.

item.name: The Sinestro Corps War
item.description: Fear takes form as Sinestro builds an army powered by terror and launches a full-scale assault on the Green Lantern Corps, turning the war for the universe into a battle between will and fear itself. Hal Jordan, Kyle Rayner, and the Corps fight to hold the line as the Sinestro Corps unleashes chaos across space, backed by monsters like Superboy-Prime and the Anti-Monitor. Worlds burn, laws break, and the Guardians push their own rules to the limit just to survive. Written by Geoff Johns with explosive art by Ivan Reis, Sinestro Corps War (2007–2008) redefines the Green Lantern mythos and ignites a conflict where fear spreads faster than light—and only the strongest will can stop it.

item.name: World War Hulk
item.description:
Exiled from Earth by the Illuminati, Hulk returns stronger than ever—and out for justice. With his adopted world destroyed and nothing left to lose, he brings the war to those who sent him away, targeting Iron Man, Doctor Strange, and the rest of the architects behind his exile.

As New York becomes a battlefield, Earth’s mightiest heroes fall one by one before a force driven by rage and grief. But beneath the destruction lies a deeper question: when the strongest hero on Earth demands justice, who has the power—or the right—to stop him?

Led by Greg Pak and John Romita Jr., World War Hulk is a brutal reckoning—where vengeance shakes the Marvel Universe to its core.

item.name: Batman R.I.P.
item.description: A secret cabal known as the Black Glove sets out to destroy Batman—not by breaking his body, but by dismantling his mind piece by piece. As Bruce Wayne faces a relentless psychological assault, buried memories resurface, identities fracture, and reality itself begins to slip away. Stripped of his resources and hunted on every side, Batman must rely on something deeper than training or preparation to survive. Written by Grant Morrison with haunting, surreal art by Tony Daniel, Batman R.I.P. (2008) plunges into the Dark Knight’s psyche and asks a brutal question: when everything else is gone, what remains of Batman?

item.name: Final Crisis
item.description: Darkseid falls—and drags reality down with him. As the god of tyranny spreads the Anti-Life Equation across Earth, free will collapses and heroes turn into servants of a world already lost. Batman, Superman, and the last resistance fighters push back against a victory that has already happened, striking from the shadows while existence itself begins to unravel. From hidden wars in the streets to battles that span the multiverse, every move carries impossible weight. Written by Grant Morrison with bold, cosmic art by J.G. Jones and Doug Mahnke, Final Crisis (2008) unleashes a relentless, mind-bending descent where evil wins first—and the fight to undo it may come too late.

item.name: Secret Invasion
item.description:
For years, the shapeshifting Skrulls have been infiltrating Earth—replacing heroes, leaders, and allies without detection. When the truth finally erupts, no one knows who to trust as the invasion reveals itself from within.

As the Avengers and their allies scramble to respond, the enemy isn’t just outside—it’s already among them. With loyalties shattered and paranoia spreading, the battle for Earth becomes a desperate fight to reclaim a world that may have already been lost.

Led by Brian Michael Bendis and Leinil Francis Yu, Secret Invasion is a high-stakes conspiracy thriller—where the greatest weapon isn’t power, but deception.

item.name: Battle for the Cowl
item.description: Batman is gone—and Gotham begins to tear itself apart. As criminals flood the streets and old enemies seize power, the question no one can ignore rises to the surface: who will become the next Batman? Nightwing, Robin, and a dangerous, unhinged Jason Todd each stake their claim, turning the symbol of the Bat into a battleground. With the city spiraling into chaos and the legacy of Batman hanging in the balance, every choice carries weight far beyond the mask. Written by Tony Daniel with gritty, high-impact art to match, Battle for the Cowl (2009) pits legacy against ambition in a fight to define what Batman truly stands for.

item.name: Blackest Night
item.description: Death refuses to stay buried as black rings descend from the darkness, raising the fallen to hunt the living and feed on their strongest emotions. As friends, family, and legends return as relentless enemies, Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps scramble to unite rival factions of the emotional spectrum against a force that grows stronger with every heartbeat. Heroes across the DC Universe face their deepest grief and rage while the war against the dead spirals into something far more cosmic and inevitable. Guided by Geoff Johns and brought to life with sweeping, visceral art by Ivan Reis, Blackest Night (2009–2010) turns loss into a weapon and builds toward a clash where life itself must fight to survive.

item.name: Brightest Day
item.description:
In the aftermath of Blackest Night, twelve heroes and villains are brought back to life—but their return is only the beginning. Guided by the mysterious power of the White Lantern, figures like Aquaman, Martian Manhunter, and Deadman are set on a path of cryptic missions that will determine the fate of life itself.

As the secrets behind their resurrection unfold, a hidden force tied to the balance between life and death begins to emerge—one that threatens to reshape the natural order of the DC Universe.

Led by Geoff Johns and Peter J. Tomasi, Brightest Day is a sweeping follow-up to Blackest Night—where rebirth is not a gift, but a test, and the future of life itself hangs in the balance.

item.name: Necrosha
item.description: Selene has raised the dead—and the millions of mutants slaughtered on Genosha are only the beginning. As the Black Queen unleashes resurrected allies and enemies against Utopia in her bid for godhood, X-Force, the X-Men, and the New Mutants must survive an army of their own dead before mutantkind becomes fuel for her ascension. From Craig Kyle, Christopher Yost, Mike Carey, Zeb Wells, and Clayton Crain, Necrosha turns the mutant past into a weapon of vengeance.

item.name: New Krypton
item.description: A lost world returns when Kandor, the bottled city of Krypton, is restored to full size—bringing thousands of Kryptonians back to life under Earth’s yellow sun. As a new society rises with powers equal to Superman’s, fear and tension spread across the planet, and old loyalties begin to fracture. Caught between two worlds, Superman must choose where he truly belongs while navigating politics, power, and the growing divide between humanity and his own people. Written by Geoff Johns, James Robinson, and Greg Rucka, Superman: New Krypton (2008–2010) expands Superman’s world into a sweeping saga of identity, culture, and the cost of having an entire race of gods living among men.

item.name: Utopia
item.description: San Francisco is burning, mutant unrest is exploding in the streets, and Norman Osborn has arrived to impose order—with his Dark Avengers and his own handpicked team of “X-Men.” But Cyclops has a plan of his own, one that will force mutantkind to choose between life under humanity’s boot or a nation all its own. From Matt Fraction, Marc Silvestri, Terry Dodson, Luke Ross, and Mike Deodato Jr., Utopia pits the X-Men against Osborn’s regime and marks the birth of mutantkind’s island sanctuary.

item.name: War of Kings
item.description: Two empires stand on the brink of annihilation. With Vulcan’s Shi’ar war machine expanding across the stars and Black Bolt’s Inhumans claiming the throne of the Kree, the galaxy is plunged into a conflict that will leave no cosmic power untouched. From Dan Abnett, Andy Lanning, and Paul Pelletier, War of Kings brings the Guardians of the Galaxy, Nova, the Starjammers, and the Inhumans into a sweeping battle for the fate of the Marvel cosmos.

item.name: Batman: The Return of Bruce Wayne
item.description: Lost in time after his clash with Darkseid, Bruce Wayne fights his way back to the present by surviving every era history can throw at him—from prehistoric hunts to pirate seas and the lawless Wild West. But something follows him through time, turning his return into a ticking clock that threatens to unleash catastrophe the moment he reaches home. As each lifetime tests his will, skill, and identity, Bruce proves that Batman isn’t just a man—it’s an idea that endures across centuries. Written by Grant Morrison with bold, era-spanning art by Chris Sprouse and others, The Return of Bruce Wayne (2010) turns a journey through time into a test of what makes Batman unbreakable.

item.name: Chaos War
item.description: The Chaos King is coming—and he means to return all creation to the nothingness that came before existence itself. As gods fall, the dead rise, and the universe begins to unravel, Hercules must assemble Thor, the Silver Surfer, Galactus, and a new God Squad for one final war against oblivion. From Greg Pak, Fred Van Lente, and Khoi Pham, Chaos War brings the saga of the Incredible Hercules to an apocalyptic battle for all reality.

item.name: Justice League: Rise and Fall
item.description: The Justice League fractures from within as the consequences of past choices finally come due. When a devastating personal loss sends Green Arrow down a path of vengeance, his actions force the League to confront the limits of justice, accountability, and their own authority. As heroes turn on one another and trust begins to crumble, the line between right and wrong grows harder to define. Written by J.T. Krul with sharp, grounded art, Justice League: Rise and Fall (2010) zeroes in on the cost of heroism when even the world’s greatest team can’t escape the fallout of its own decisions.

Nova, the Guardians of the Galaxy and the Inhumans try to hold the line as its forces push through, and the one weapon that might end it is Thanos, brought back and barely under control. item.name: Shadowland
item.description:
After seizing control of the Hand, Daredevil builds a fortress in Hell’s Kitchen and declares war on crime—but something darker has taken hold. As his justice turns brutal and absolute, street-level heroes like Spider-Man, Luke Cage, and Iron Fist are forced to confront a friend who may no longer be a hero.

With the city caught in a rising tide of violence and fear, the battle becomes a desperate effort to save not just New York—but the soul of Daredevil himself.

Led by Andy Diggle and Billy Tan, Shadowland is a dark street-level crossover—where power, corruption, and redemption collide in the shadows.

item.name: Siege
item.description:
With fear and power firmly in his grasp, Norman Osborn launches a full-scale assault on Asgard, seeking to cement his control by bringing down the gods themselves. Backed by the Dark Avengers and the might of the S.H.I.E.L.D. he commands, Osborn turns a political crusade into open war.

As Thor stands against the invasion and the unstable force of the Sentry threatens to tear everything apart, heroes rally for a final stand that will decide the fate of both Earth and Asgard. In the end, the battle doesn’t just topple a regime—it resets the balance of power across the Marvel Universe.

Led by Brian Michael Bendis and Olivier Coipel, Siege is the explosive climax of the Dark Reign era—where ambition, power, and reckoning collide at the gates of Asgard.

item.name: Age of X
item.description: In a world where the X-Men never existed, mutantkind has been hunted to the edge of extinction—and the last survivors have gathered inside Fortress X for one final stand against humanity. But as the walls close in and buried memories begin to surface, the heroes of this dying world must uncover the truth behind their reality before the last mutants fall. From Mike Carey, Clay Mann, Steve Kurth, and more, Age of X traps the X-Men in a world built on fear, war, and a secret that should never have existed.

item.name: Fear Itself
item.description:
When the ancient Asgardian god of fear, Serpent, rises to claim the world, terror becomes a weapon. Mystical hammers crash to Earth, transforming heroes and villains alike into the unstoppable Worthy, each driven by their deepest fears.

As chaos spreads and the Avengers are pushed to the brink, Thor and Captain America lead a desperate stand against a force tied to the very foundations of Asgard. With the world consumed by panic, victory will demand sacrifice—and the forging of new legends.

Led by Matt Fraction and Stuart Immonen, Fear Itself is a mythic Marvel event—where fear itself becomes the enemy, and even gods can fall.

item.name: Flashpoint
item.description:
Time breaks when Barry Allen makes one impossible choice—he saves his mother. In an instant, the world reshapes into something unrecognizable: Atlantis and Themyscira wage a devastating war, Batman is Thomas Wayne, and a weakened Superman exists as little more than a secret experiment. As reality fractures under the weight of a single altered moment, Barry must navigate a world that shouldn’t exist and confront the consequences of trying to fix the past.

Driven by Geoff Johns with sharp, high-impact storytelling, Flashpoint (2011) turns a personal act of love into a global catastrophe, building toward a desperate race to restore the timeline. In doing so, it reshapes the DC Universe itself, marking the end of one era and the beginning of the New 52.

item.name: I, Vampire: Rise of the Vampires
item.description: Andrew Bennett is dead—and with the vampire world’s greatest restraint gone, the blood-hungry legions of the undead are free to rise against humanity. As Cain leads an army of vampires toward open war, Justice League Dark must enter the fray before the end of magic becomes the end of life itself. From Joshua Hale Fialkov, Peter Milligan, Andrea Sorrentino, and Daniel Sampere, Rise of the Vampires brings DC’s supernatural heroes together for a blood-soaked battle against the first vampire.

item.name: Schism
item.description:
Mutantkind is barely surviving when a new wave of fear, violence, and anti-mutant hysteria pushes the X-Men to a breaking point. As threats close in from every side, Cyclops and Wolverine clash over the future of their people—and what they are willing to ask the next generation to sacrifice.

What begins as a disagreement over leadership becomes a philosophical rupture: Cyclops sees young mutants as soldiers in a war for survival, while Wolverine believes they deserve the childhood that was stolen from him. By the end, the X-Men are no longer one family, but two competing visions of mutantkind’s future.

Led by Jason Aaron, Carlos Pacheco, Frank Cho, Daniel Acuña, Alan Davis, and Adam Kubert, Schism is a defining X-Men crossover—where ideology, trauma, and leadership fracture the mutant world and set the stage for Avengers vs. X-Men.

item.name: Spider-Island
item.description: Everyone in Manhattan has spider-powers—and with great power spreading through the city comes chaos on a scale even Spider-Man has never faced. As the Jackal and the Spider-Queen turn New York into their own twisted kingdom, Peter Parker must save a city where anyone can do what he does before the whole island becomes something monstrous. From Dan Slott, Humberto Ramos, and Stefano Caselli, Spider-Island turns Spider-Man’s greatest gift into Manhattan’s deadliest outbreak.

item.name: War of the Green Lanterns
item.description: The Green Lantern Corps turns on itself when Krona seizes control of the Guardians and unleashes Parallax, corrupting the very heart of Oa. Stripped of their rings and hunted by their own allies, Hal Jordan, Guy Gardner, John Stewart, and Kyle Rayner break the rules and wield the power of rival Corps—fear, rage, hope, and more—just to survive. As trust collapses and the Corps descends into chaos, the war for Oa becomes a battle over what the Green Lanterns truly stand for. Written by Geoff Johns with dynamic, high-intensity art, War of the Green Lanterns (2011) pushes the emotional spectrum to its limits and forces its greatest champions to embrace everything they were taught to resist.

War of the Green Lanterns: Aftermath

item.name: Avengers vs. X-Men
item.description:
When the cosmic Phoenix Force returns to Earth, the Avengers and the X-Men clash over its fate. Captain America sees an extinction-level threat, while Cyclops believes it represents salvation for mutantkind.

As the Phoenix fragments and empowers the X-Men’s leaders, turning them into the Phoenix Five, the conflict escalates into a global war that fractures alliances and pushes both sides beyond their limits. With the future of mutants—and the world—at stake, victory comes at a devastating cost that reshapes the balance between humans and mutants.

Led by Brian Michael Bendis, Jason Aaron, Ed Brubaker, Matt Fraction, Jonathan Hickman, and John Romita Jr., Avengers vs. X-Men is a massive crossover—where ideology turns allies into enemies, and the future is forged in conflict.

item.name: Death of the Family
item.description: The Joker returns—and this time, he doesn’t want to destroy Batman. He wants to prove that everything around him is the real weakness. As the Clown Prince of Crime wages a calculated, relentless campaign against Gotham and the entire Bat-family, he targets the bonds that hold them together, turning trust into doubt and loyalty into fear. Every move pushes Batman closer to a breaking point, forcing him to confront whether his allies make him stronger—or make him vulnerable. Driven by Scott Snyder with razor-sharp, haunting art by Greg Capullo, Batman: Death of the Family (2012–2013) twists the hero’s greatest strength into his greatest liability and builds toward a confrontation that leaves nothing untouched.

item.name: Night of Owls
item.description: Gotham’s darkest secret strikes all at once as the Court of Owls unleashes its army of undead assassins—the Talons—to hunt down the city’s power players in a single, coordinated assault. As the night descends into chaos, Batman and the entire Bat-family scatter across Gotham to protect allies, defend territory, and uncover just how deep the Court’s influence runs. Every corner of the city becomes a battlefield, and every victory reveals another layer of a conspiracy that has watched Gotham for centuries. Driven by Scott Snyder with sharp, kinetic storytelling across the Bat-line, Night of the Owls (2012) turns Gotham into a war zone and forces Batman to confront a truth he can’t easily control: the city has always had other masters.

item.name: Rotworld
item.description: The world falls—and keeps falling. In a future where The Rot has consumed everything, Anton Arcane rules over a dead Earth where decay spreads unchecked and hope has long since withered. Pulled into this nightmare, Swamp Thing and Animal Man must navigate a landscape where life has already lost, rallying what remains of The Green and The Red for one last chance to turn the tide. Every step forward reveals a world that shouldn’t exist and enemies that can’t truly die. Written by Scott Snyder and Jeff Lemire, Rotworld (2012–2013) plunges into horror and despair, building a relentless vision of a universe overtaken by decay—and the fragile fight to reclaim it.

item.name: Throne of Atlantis
item.description: War rises from the depths when Atlantis declares open conflict against the surface world, unleashing tidal devastation on a global scale. As cities fall and armies clash, Aquaman stands at the center of the storm—torn between his role as a member of the Justice League and his claim to the throne of Atlantis. Facing his own brother, the ruthless Ocean Master, Arthur must decide what kind of king—and what kind of hero—he will become. Driven by Geoff Johns with cinematic, high-impact art, Throne of Atlantis (2012–2013) delivers a sweeping battle of kingdoms where loyalty, legacy, and power collide beneath the waves.

item.name: Age of Ultron
item.description: Ultron has won. New York lies in ruins, Earth’s heroes are scattered, and the machine tyrant’s drones hunt the last survivors through the wreckage of a conquered world. With no path left but the impossible, Wolverine and the Invisible Woman launch a desperate mission through time itself to stop Ultron before his age can ever begin. From Brian Michael Bendis, Bryan Hitch, Brandon Peterson, and Carlos Pacheco, Age of Ultron brings the Marvel Universe to the brink of extinction in a last-ditch war against its deadliest artificial intelligence.

item.name: Battle of the Atom
item.description: The past has overstayed its welcome. The future has come to collect. When tomorrow’s X-Men arrive demanding the original five return to their own time, mutantkind fractures over whom to trust. But these visitors are hiding secrets—and another future is fighting to be heard. Three generations collide in a battle over the fate of the X-Men. With history itself on the line, which side deserves to survive?

item.name: Forever Evil
item.description: Evil wins—and this time, no one stands in the way. With the Justice League gone, the Crime Syndicate seizes control of Earth and reshapes the world under their rule, crushing resistance and turning hope into fear. As the planet falls into darkness, unlikely figures rise to challenge them, led by Lex Luthor, who refuses to bow to anyone—even gods from another world. Villains become the last line of defense, alliances form where they never should, and every move carries the weight of a world already lost. Driven by Geoff Johns with explosive, high-stakes storytelling, Forever Evil (2013–2014) flips the DC Universe on its head and asks a dangerous question: when heroes fail, who saves the world?

issues.series_name: Forever Evil Aftermath: Batman vs. Bane

item.name: Infinity
item.description:
While the Avengers wage a desperate interstellar war against the godlike Builders, Earth is left vulnerable—just as Thanos arrives with the Black Order to claim a hidden prize tied to the Inhuman royal line.

As two fronts collapse into one, heroes must split their forces between a cosmic battlefield and a homeworld under siege. The conflict reshapes the balance of power across the universe, culminating in a world-altering event that unleashes the Inhuman population on a global scale.

Led by Jonathan Hickman, Jim Cheung, and Jerome Opeña, Infinity is a sweeping cosmic epic—where war spans the stars, and the fate of Earth is decided on two fronts.

item.name: Lights Out
item.description: The lights begin to die. As Lantern rings across the universe start to fail, a forgotten being known as Relic emerges with a devastating truth—the emotional spectrum is not limitless, and every use of its power brings the universe closer to collapse. As energy drains from every Corps, Hal Jordan, Kyle Rayner, and the Lanterns face an enemy they can’t simply defeat, one who forces them to question the very source of their power. Alliances strain, abilities falter, and the war for survival becomes a race against extinction itself. Spanning the Lantern titles, Lights Out (2013) challenges the foundation of the Green Lantern mythos and asks what happens when the power that fuels heroes becomes the threat that could end everything.

item.name: Rise of the Third Army/Wrath of the First Lantern
item.description:
The Guardians of the Universe make their final play for control—and unleash a nightmare that turns the Green Lantern Corps against itself. With the creation of the Third Army, entire worlds fall as living beings lose their will and become extensions of a cold, ordered vision of the universe. As Oa slips from their grasp and the Corps fractures under betrayal, Hal Jordan, Sinestro, John Stewart, Guy Gardner, and Kyle Rayner fight to survive a war engineered by their own creators.

But the true reckoning arrives with the rise of the First Lantern, Volthoom, a being who doesn’t just attack the present—he rewrites the past. Dragging heroes and villains through twisted visions of what their lives could have been, Volthoom forces every Lantern to confront regret, identity, and the fragile choices that define them. As reality bends and the emotional spectrum reaches its breaking point, the fate of the Corps—and the truth behind its origins—comes to light.

item.name: Trinity War
item.description: Three Justice Leagues collide when a single act of violence sparks a chain reaction none of them can control. As Superman, Batman, and their allies turn on one another, the mystery of Pandora’s Box pulls heroes into a conflict that blurs the line between power, magic, and manipulation. Trust fractures, agendas clash, and every revelation points to a deeper game unfolding behind the scenes. Driven by Geoff Johns and a rotating team across the Justice League titles, Trinity War (2013) ignites a battle between heroes that exposes hidden forces at work—and sets the stage for a far greater threat waiting just beyond the fallout.

item.name: AXIS
item.description:
When the twisted fusion of Red Skull and Onslaught unleashes a psychic assault on the world, a desperate counterspell backfires—inverting the moral compasses of heroes and villains alike.

Suddenly, Earth’s greatest champions become ruthless and self-serving, while its worst monsters turn toward uneasy redemption. As chaos spreads and identities fracture, unlikely alliances form in a battle to restore the world before its heroes become its greatest threat.

Led by Rick Remender and Jim Cheung, AXIS is a reality-twisting crossover—where the line between hero and villain doesn’t just blur… it flips.

item.name: Death of Wolverine
item.description: He’s survived wars, monsters, and the worst humanity could offer. Now Wolverine’s healing factor is gone—and someone has put a price on his head. With enemies closing in, Logan follows the hunt back to its source for one final reckoning. Every wound lasts. Every fight could be his last. How does a man who’s lived through everything face the end?

item.name: Endgame
item.description: The Joker returns with a plan to end everything—starting with Gotham itself. Unleashing a deadly contagion that twists allies into enemies, he turns the city into a war zone and forces Batman to face threats he can’t outthink or outrun. Even the Justice League falls under the Joker’s influence, leaving Batman isolated as the chaos spirals beyond control. As the truth behind the Joker’s obsession comes into focus, their conflict escalates into a brutal, final confrontation that pushes both men to their limits. Driven by Scott Snyder with intense, cinematic art by Greg Capullo, Batman: Endgame (2014–2015) delivers a relentless clash where the line between hero and nightmare blurs—and neither side walks away unchanged.

item.name: Futures End
item.description:
Five years from now, the world has fallen. A rogue Brother Eye has turned Earth into a machine-controlled nightmare, and the last survivors are fighting a losing war. When Batman Beyond is sent back in time to prevent the apocalypse, his mission sets off a chain of events that begins to reshape the present.

As heroes and outcasts—from Firestorm to Frankenstein—are drawn into a hidden conflict, the future begins to bleed into the now, revealing a world on the brink of becoming something far worse than anyone imagined.

Led by Brian Azzarello, Jeff Lemire, Dan Jurgens, and Keith Giffen, Futures End is a sprawling weekly crossover—where the fight to save tomorrow begins by changing today.

item.name: Godhead
item.description: A new war ignites when the New Gods of New Genesis turn their attention to the emotional spectrum, seeking to seize the power of the Lantern Corps and bend it to their will. Led by Highfather and Orion, they launch a campaign across the universe, stripping Lanterns of their rings and forcing the Corps into a desperate fight for survival. At the center of the conflict, Kyle Rayner—the White Lantern—becomes the key to a power neither side fully understands. As gods and Lanterns collide, alliances fracture and the balance of the cosmos hangs in the balance. Green Lantern: Godhead (2014–2015) unleashes a clash of divine ambition and emotional power where even the gods must reckon with forces beyond their control.

item.name: Original Sin
item.description: The Watcher is dead—and someone has stolen his eyes. As the heroes of the Marvel Universe hunt for Uatu’s killer, the secrets he has seen across a lifetime begin spilling into the light, exposing buried sins that could tear allies apart and change lives forever. From Jason Aaron and Mike Deodato, Original Sin turns Marvel’s greatest mystery into a murder investigation where no hero is safe from the truth.

item.name: Red Daughter
item.description: Rage finds a new bearer when Supergirl loses control—and gains a Red Lantern ring. Fueled by grief, anger, and a lifetime of loss, Kara Zor-El unleashes a power that burns hotter the more it consumes her, turning her into something far more dangerous than she’s ever been. As she tears across the galaxy under the watch of Atrocitus, every battle pushes her closer to losing herself completely. But buried beneath the fury, something still fights to be heard. Driven by raw emotion and high-impact action, Supergirl: Red Daughter of Krypton (2014) transforms one of DC’s brightest heroes into a force of unfiltered rage—and dares to ask what survives when anger takes everything else away.

item.name: Spider-Verse
item.description:
Across the multiverse, the Spider-totems begin to fall. As the Inheritors hunt Spider-heroes from reality to reality, scattered champions are drawn into a war they barely understand—each one a different answer to what Spider-Man can be.

From Spider-Gwen’s debut to stranger, darker, and wildly reimagined Spider-heroes, Edge of Spider-Verse expands the mythos before the multiverse-wide battle begins.

Led by Dan Slott, Jason Latour, Robbi Rodriguez, Dustin Weaver, Gerard Way, Jake Wyatt, and other creators, Edge of Spider-Verse is the gateway to Spider-Verse—a showcase of alternate Spider-legends where every new web-slinger may be another target.

item.name: Convergence
item.description: Worlds that should no longer exist return. Plucked from across time and torn from forgotten timelines, entire cities fall under domes controlled by Brainiac, forcing heroes from every era of the DC Universe into a brutal test of survival. With powers stripped away and escape impossible, champions of different worlds collide, each fighting to protect what remains of their reality. As the scope of the experiment comes into focus, the battle shifts from survival to something greater—whether these lost histories still deserve a place in existence. Convergence (2015) gathers the many versions of the DC Universe into one collision of legacy, identity, and the enduring question of what stories truly matter.

item.name: Darkseid War
item.description: Gods go to war—and the Justice League stands in the middle. When Darkseid clashes with the Anti-Monitor, their battle tears across the cosmos and drags Earth into a conflict far beyond human scale. As the war escalates, the League doesn’t just fight—it transforms. Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, and even Lex Luthor take on godlike power, reshaping their roles in ways that challenge everything they stand for. With reality buckling under the weight of ancient forces and impossible choices, victory comes at a cost no one can escape. Driven by Geoff Johns with sweeping, cinematic scope, Darkseid War (2015–2016) delivers a cosmic showdown where heroes rise to meet the power of gods—and risk becoming something else entirely.

item.name: Final Days of Superman
item.description:
Superman begins to die—and the world can’t stop it. As a mysterious energy burns through his body, the New 52 Superman fights to save as many lives as he can with the time he has left, pushing himself beyond every limit even as his powers unravel. Allies gather, enemies close in, and every moment carries the weight of a final stand for a hero who refuses to quit.

But this is more than an ending—it’s a turning point. As this version of Superman falls, the path opens for the return of the pre-Flashpoint Superman, reshaping the Man of Steel for a new era. Spanning the Superman titles, The Final Days of Superman (2016) delivers a last, desperate run for one incarnation of the hero while marking the transition from the New 52 to the Superman who will define the Rebirth era.

item.name: Secret Wars
item.description:
As the multiverse collapses under the weight of endless incursions, the final fragments of reality are fused into a single world—Battleworld—ruled by the godlike Doctor Doom.

In a patchwork realm stitched together from broken universes, survivors from across existence awaken to a world where Doom is absolute, and memory of what came before is fading. But as a small group of heroes—including Reed Richards—begin to remember the truth, a final rebellion forms to challenge a ruler who saved everything… by remaking it in his image.

Led by Jonathan Hickman and Esad Ribić, Secret Wars is Marvel’s ultimate convergence—where worlds die, are reborn, and the fate of the multiverse is decided one last time.

item.name: The Black Vortex
item.description: An ancient artifact has resurfaced—one with the power to unlock the cosmic potential hidden inside anyone who gazes into it. As the Black Vortex falls into the hands of Mister Knife and the Slaughter Lords, the Guardians of the Galaxy and the X-Men are drawn into a star-spanning struggle over power, temptation, and what their heroes might become if they stop holding back. From Sam Humphries, Brian Michael Bendis, Ed McGuinness, and more, The Black Vortex sends Marvel’s mutant and cosmic heroes into a battle for evolution itself.

item.name: Civil War II
item.description:
When an Inhuman named Ulysses gains the power to predict the future, the Marvel Universe fractures over a dangerous question: should you stop crimes before they happen?

Captain Marvel embraces the power as a tool for prevention, while Iron Man sees it as a threat to free will—igniting a conflict that once again turns heroes against each other.

As predictions lead to devastating consequences and trust collapses, the line between protection and control blurs, forcing the Marvel Universe to confront whether knowing the future is worth the cost of choosing it.

Led by Brian Michael Bendis and David Marquez, Civil War II is a divisive modern crossover—where certainty becomes the most dangerous weapon of all.

item.name: DC Rebirth
item.description:
A forgotten hero returns—and with him, the truth about what the DC Universe has lost. Pulled back from the Speed Force, Wally West races across a world that no longer remembers him, uncovering a deeper mystery behind the fractured timeline left in the wake of Flashpoint. As he searches for someone who will believe him, the answer comes into focus: history hasn’t just changed—it’s been stolen.

Guided by Geoff Johns, DC Universe: Rebirth (2016) restores legacy, relationships, and hope to a universe that had lost its sense of itself, while revealing a shadowy hand behind the missing years. More than a story, it marks the turning point into a new era—one where the past matters again, and the future begins to reconnect with everything that came before.

item.name: Inhumans vs X-Men
item.description:
The Terrigen Mist that empowers the Inhumans is slowly poisoning mutantkind—turning the survival of one species into the extinction of another. As time runs out, the X-Men launch a preemptive strike to destroy the source, igniting a full-scale war between two peoples fighting for their future.

With leaders like Medusa and Emma Frost making impossible choices, the conflict escalates into a desperate battle where coexistence may no longer be possible—and victory comes at the cost of everything both sides are trying to protect.

Led by Charles Soule, Jeff Lemire, and Leinil Francis Yu, Inhumans vs. X-Men is a high-stakes crossover—where survival drives heroes into war, and the future of two species hangs in the balance.

item.name: Justice League vs. Suicide Squad
item.description: The world’s greatest heroes clash with its most dangerous criminals when Batman uncovers a secret that should never have existed—the Suicide Squad. As the Justice League moves to shut Amanda Waller’s black-ops program down, the confrontation spirals into a full-scale battle between teams that were never meant to meet. But the real threat emerges from the shadows, forcing enemies to become uneasy allies against a power neither side can control. Packed with explosive action and sharp character clashes, Justice League vs Suicide Squad (2016–2017) throws two opposing visions of justice into direct conflict—and reveals the dangerous truths that bind them together.

item.name: The Clone Conspiracy
item.description: The dead are back—and they remember everything. When a mysterious new Jackal offers Peter Parker the impossible chance to reunite with lost loved ones and fallen enemies alike, Spider-Man is pulled into a nightmare where resurrection comes with a hidden cost. From Dan Slott, Jim Cheung, Giuseppe Camuncoli, and more, The Clone Conspiracy brings Spider-Man face-to-face with grief, temptation, and the horrifying consequences of trying to undo death.

item.name: Dark Nights: Metal
item.description:
A dark truth rises from beneath reality when the Dark Multiverse breaks through and unleashes nightmare versions of Batman upon the world. Led by the terrifying Batman Who Laughs and the ancient god Barbatos, these twisted reflections bring with them a wave of chaos that reshapes the very structure of existence. As the Justice League struggles to understand a threat born from fear itself, hidden connections between Batman, metal, and the multiverse come to light.

Driven by Scott Snyder with explosive, high-concept storytelling, Dark Nights: Metal (2017–2018) fuses cosmic mythology with raw, heavy-metal energy, turning the DC Universe into a battlefield between hope and its darkest possibilities—and opening the door to a new, more dangerous multiverse beyond anything seen before.
